name: sonner
useFor: Use to confirm something that happened in the background or will undo (API key copied, agent created, webhook paused). Mount Toaster once near the root and call toast(), toast.success(), toast.error() or toast.promise() from anywhere. Give undoable actions an action button.
constraints: A toast for an error that blocks the task (say it in place instead)
More than one sentence of description
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): white floating panels, filled status glyphs and the purple action
title: Sonner
description: Toasts as white floating panels with a filled status glyph, an ink title, a muted description and a purple action.
